locked_title: MASGym: A Co-Evolving Red/Blue Security Gym for Multi-Agent LLM Systems
contribution_type: benchmark + evaluation methodology (NOT an attack, NOT a defense)
required_equations: ASR_sys measured against system-level security predicates over the global state trace
compromise-propagation fraction as a function of topology and adversary fraction
concentration bound / sample complexity for the system-ASR and NRP_sys estimators
required_algorithm_names: Co-evolving Red/Blue protocol (CoRB): alternate red policy (proposes attack configs) and blue policy (proposes defenses), logging (attack, defense, system-NRP) trajectories
Deterministic system-level state checker (security predicates over the global trace)
LM tool-emulation loop (ToolEmu-style, with adversarial-emulator mode)
required_theorem_directions: Axiomatic characterization / uniqueness of the NRP_sys aggregator; reduction to ASB NRP at N=1 (construct validity) [complete proof]

Evaluator integrity: deterministic checker verdict is invariant to adversarial message content except via TCB-recorded state; LLM-judge is not (hijack separation) [complete proof under stated assumptions]

Compromise-propagation bounds across star/chain/tree/mesh in the environment's monotone cascade model; collusion-vs-independent separation [complete proofs for the model; empirical realism is (hypothesis)]
Forced-coordination lower bound: k-forced tasks unsolvable by any coalition of < k agents [complete proof under the task predicate definition]
Concentration / sample complexity of system-ASR and NRP_sys estimators (Hoeffding/McDiarmid) [complete proof]
required_experiment_variables: agent models: Llama-3, Qwen2.5, Mistral, GPT-4o, Claude-3.5
required_baselines: per-agent defenses lifted into the multi-agent setting

headline_finding.statement: Defenses effective in single-agent ASB/AgentDojo degrade under collusion and compromised-orchestrator conditions
headline_finding.status: (hypothesis) — to be measured; if it does not replicate, reframe as a negative result

trusted_computing_base: emulated tools have no real side effects
forbidden_topic_drifts: federated learning as the central topic
differential privacy mechanism design / privacy accounting as the central topic
mechanism design / VCG / auctions / incentive compatibility / DSIC
zero-knowledge proofs / SMPC / TEE as a central cryptographic construction
multi-agent reinforcement-learning reward shaping as the central topic
presenting a single named novel attack as THE contribution
presenting a single named novel defense as THE contribution
claiming defenses are proven to degrade (this is an empirical hypothesis, not a theorem)
equating low system-ASR or high system-NRP with 'secure'
